nodes.title: SU2 8.5 2-D RANS runs, team/B2/sim/cfd2d_section.py
nodes.where: team/B2/sim/out/cfd2d_results.json; INC_RANS Spalart-Allmaras fully turbulent, gmsh meshes 9k/18k/36k cells (refinement sqrt 2), quad boundary layer, far field 50 c
nodes.note: fully turbulent: no laminar separation bubble, so clmax and hinge moments bracket XFOIL rather than replace it; not compared with test data at this Re

nodes.title: Trimmed CLmax follows the static margin
nodes.text: The pod and propellers change the trimmed CLmax only through the NP shift; trimmed CLmax is read from the props-off wing + fin model at the same static margin as the real aircraft (B3 NP)
nodes.basis: R2 sweep: CLmax depends on SM, not on CG station (WING-AERO.md section 3); the pod carries no elevon and sits on the wing root strip that never stalls first (first stall y 0.071 m is the inboard elevon end, outside the pod's 0.07 m half-width)

nodes.title: Full elevon travel up to VA 20.5 m/s
nodes.text: Elevon hinge moments: 25 deg at VA 20.5 m/s and <= 1/3 travel (8.33 deg) at VD
nodes.basis: params requirements.vd_ms note (D-50, F4 CR-F4-12): full travel to VA 20.5 m/s, <= 1/3 at VD held by the flight envelope

nodes.title: Grid uncertainty limit
nodes.text: A CFD number that drives a requirement must have a fine-grid GCI <= 5 %
nodes.basis: Roache GCI, Fs 1.25, three levels at r = sqrt 2 (SIM-TOOLS.md practice)

nodes.title: Discretisation acceptance rule
nodes.text: An XFOIL panel or AVL lattice value used for a requirement is accepted if the finest level run gives a value at least as favourable (the value used is conservative); the spread is reported
nodes.basis: clmax spreads 1.7 % (XFOIL 160-400 panels, monotone rising) and 1.6 % (AVL, non-monotone) exceed the 1 % used in R2; a conservative value is the professional fallback

nodes.title: Stall speed at the as-designed CG points and masses
nodes.equation: SM = (Xnp_B3 - x_cg)/c; CLmax = kd * interp(SM, CLmax(SM)); Vs = sqrt(2 m g / (rho b c CLmax)); Re correction: CLmax *= 1 + s (Re_s - Re_x)/1e5

nodes.title: Stall at the forward CG if the boundary layer were turbulent from the LE
nodes.equation: CLmax' = CLmax_fwd * clmax_turb / clmax_free; Vs' = Vs_fwd sqrt(clmax_free / clmax_turb); clmax_turb = XFOIL tripped at 2 % c (lower bound) or SU2 SA L2 sweep max

nodes.title: Elevon hinge moment per servo, VA full travel and VD 1/3 travel
nodes.equation: H = C_h q c^2 s; C_h(25) = XFOIL inviscid max (design), C_h(8.3) = interp of XFOIL inviscid max at 5 and 10 deg; T_servo = SF * max(H) * k_linkage (envelope: 25 deg to VA, 1/3 at VD); T_servo_vdfull = SF * H(25 deg, VD) * k_linkage (R-SERVO-TORQUE as written); ratio_visc = max(|C_h SU2 L2 alpha -4|, SU2 bound alpha 0) / C_h XFOIL inviscid

nodes.title: Discretisation checks: XFOIL panels, AVL lattice, SU2 grid
nodes.equation: spread = (max - min) / mean over the levels; cons = finest / used - 1; GCI_fine (SU2, 3 levels)

nodes.title: Root bending at the limit load factor, AVL vs Schrenk
nodes.equation: M = n (m g / 2) ybar b/2; ratio = ybar_Schrenk / ybar_AVL
